page: Microsoft Azure E32bds_v6 is an x86_64 memory-optimized virtual machine profile within the Ebdsv6 family, virtualized via Microsoft Hyper-V. The system provisions 32 dedicated Intel vCPUs paired with 256 GB of system memory, maintaining an allocation ratio of 8 GB of RAM per virtual core. The platform operates without GPU accelerators, focusing all host resources on memory density, processing consistency, and block storage performance.

Storage capabilities are anchored by 1,890 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD capacity, delivering direct-attached high-speed scratch space. The architecture also includes Azure Premium Storage support for demanding external block volumes. While formal synthetic benchmark data is unrecorded for this specific instance, the underlying hardware baseline combines dedicated Intel compute threads with 256 GB of RAM and local NVMe throughput to handle memory-heavy and I/O-intensive pipelines.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the inclusion of 1,890 GB of local NVMe SSD alongside a 1:8 core-to-memory ratio minimizes the immediate requirement for external storage tiers when processing intermediate or temporary data. A key architectural consideration is the lack of persistent local disk retention typical of temporary NVMe drives and the absence of discrete hardware acceleration. The instance is suited for enterprise relational database systems, in-memory caches, data analytics, and operational enterprise application backends.
description: Microsoft Azure E32bds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance designed for memory-bound and storage-intensive enterprise workloads. Powered by an x86_64 Intel processor architecture and virtualized via Microsoft Hyper-V, the server provides 32 dedicated vCPUs alongside 256 GB of system memory, maintaining an 8 GB memory-to-core ratio. The configuration includes 1,890 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD temporary storage and supports Premium Storage configurations for demanding block storage tasks. It operates without discrete GPU accelerators, dedicating compute, memory, and bus capacity entirely to core system execution. By bundling high-capacity local storage and substantial memory density into a single compute footprint, the instance delivers qualitative cost efficiency for systems requiring significant memory caches alongside high-speed scratch space. The E32bds_v6 is suited for hosting transactional databases, distributed in-memory data stores, operational caching layers, enterprise resource planning applications, and large-scale data manipulation jobs.
